claims.text: Neuraminidase inhibitors (oseltamivir, zanamivir, peramivir) treat influenza A and B.
claims.quote: Oseltamivir, zanamivir, and peramivir belong to the neuraminidase inhibitors family and can be used for the treatment of influenza A and B.

claims.text: Baloxavir (Xofluza): acute uncomplicated influenza, age ≥5, Sx ≤48 h.
claims.quote: XOFLUZA is indicated for treatment of acute uncomplicated influenza in patients 5 years of age and older who have been symptomatic for no more than 48 hours
